scope: Modeless post-save presentation of existing Matplotlib figure-integrity warnings; no plot.py or detection-threshold changes.
behavior: Successful save closes its dialog normally and returns the written path before presenting warnings without a modal wait.
Read-only selectable plain-text findings preserve backend panel IDs and actionable guidance; saved file and successful provenance paths are displayed.
Open output folder targets only the saved file parent; Close never alters either output.
Only warnings or a failed provenance write open a notice; clean/disabled/non-image cases stay quiet.
Provenance failure reports permissions/retry guidance while preserving the successful figure; notice presentation failure does not invalidate save.
Notice remains alive if the parentless Save dialog is deleted, and releases on closing.
